label: Dossier
description: Every proof point at once. A rail that indexes each employer, and bullets hung on their lead figure.
signatureMoves: The hung ledger gutter: a bullet that opens on its verified figure sets that figure in a mono gutter; others get a quiet dash.
One grid row per employer, with the rail holding the logo, the name, the dates and the place.
Restraint everywhere except the numbers and the logos.
